DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真の撮影についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 花壇を撮りたいです。小さな三脚なら、通路の端に置けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通路で小型三脚を置く可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to photograph the flowerbed. Can I put a small tripod at the edge of the path?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can put a small tripod on the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは人が通るので、脚を広げて置くのはご遠慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: People pass through here, so please do not set it up with the legs spread out.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。折り畳んで手に持つ使い方ならいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三脚を畳んで手持ちにする方法を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Is it all right to fold it up and hold it in my hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest folding the tripod and holding it in your hand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その使い方なら大丈夫です。花壇の柵の内側には入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: That way is fine. Please do not go inside the fence around the flowerbed.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 柵の外から撮ります。友人にも立ってもらいたいのですが、花の前で止まってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柵外で友人を撮る可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will photograph from outside the fence. I also want my friend to stand for a photo. Can they stop in front of the flowers?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can photograph your friend outside the fence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 短い撮影なら構いません。後ろから人が来たら先に通してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: A brief photograph is fine. If people approach from behind, let them pass first.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。撮る向きを変えるなら、あちらの広場の方が空いていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行条件を了解し広場の撮影を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If we change the shooting direction, that plaza over there has more space, doesn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the conditions about people passing and ask about photography in the plaza. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 広場からも花壇が見えます。通行の少ないそちらがおすすめです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see the flowerbed from the plaza too. I recommend it because fewer people pass through.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三脚は広げず、友人と広場へ移って撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場で手持ち撮影する方針を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the tripod folded and move to the plaza with my friend to take photographs.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take handheld photographs in the plaza. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、どうぞ撮影をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご入浴はお一人ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。入浴のあと休憩室にも行きたいです。荷物は脱衣所に置いたままでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入浴後の休憩中に脱衣ロッカーを使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I also want to go to the rest area after bathing. Can I leave my belongings in the changing room?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the changing-room locker while resting after bathing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 休憩室へ出る時は、脱衣所のロッカーを空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please empty the changing-room locker when you go out to the rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、大きなかばんは先に受付で預けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きなかばんの預かり場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then can I leave my large bag at reception first?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to store your large bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの大型ロッカーが使えます。鍵はご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use this large locker. Please keep the key yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このかばんが入りますね。入浴用の小さな袋だけ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かばんを入れ入浴用袋だけ携帯すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: My bag fits in here. I will take only a small bathing bag with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put the bag away and carry only your bathing bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。脱衣所から出る際は、忘れ物をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please check for anything left behind when leaving the changing room.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩室には浴衣で行ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩室の服装を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I wear a yukata to the rest area?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check what to wear in the rest area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この施設では休憩室へ行く前に普段のお洋服へ着替えていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: At this facility, please change into your everyday clothes before going to the rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。着替えて荷物を移し、休憩後に大型ロッカーの鍵を返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 着替えと荷物移動と鍵返却を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will change, move my belongings and return the large locker's key after resting.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm changing clothes, moving belongings and returning the key. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time and relax.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I have the name on your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 田中です。二泊します。明日の午前中は部屋で仕事をする予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 連泊と翌朝の在室予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tanaka. I am staying two nights. I plan to work in my room tomorrow morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are staying multiple nights and will be in your room tomorrow morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。清掃は午前から順番に伺いますが、時間のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Cleaning starts in the morning, room by room. Do you have a preferred time?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後にしてもらえますか。十三時には外へ出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十三時以降の清掃を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Could you make it in the afternoon? I will go out at one p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request cleaning after one p.m. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 午後の清掃を手配します。シーツも交換しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will arrange afternoon cleaning. Would you like the sheets changed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: シーツはそのままで結構です。タオルの交換とごみの回収だけお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: シーツ交換を省きタオルとごみ回収を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: The sheets can stay as they are. I would like only towel replacement and rubbish collection.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Skip sheet replacement and specify towels and rubbish collection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承りました。出発前に清掃希望の札をドアに掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please hang the cleaning-request sign on the door before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外へ出る時に掛けます。飲み物の空き瓶も、ごみとして置いていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 清掃札の扱いと瓶の回収を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hang it when I go out. Can I leave empty drink bottles as rubbish too?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check how to use the cleaning sign and have bottles collected. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 瓶は机の横のトレーにまとめていただければ回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you gather the bottles on the tray beside the desk, we will collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 瓶をトレーに置き、十三時に札を掛けます。明日の午後、タオルとごみだけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収場所と清掃時間と内容をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the bottles on the tray and hang the sign at one p.m. Please do only the towels and rubbish tomorrow afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the collection place, cleaning time and tasks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。アイスコーヒー二つとホットティー一つをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持ち帰り三杯の温冷を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Two iced coffees and one hot tea, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Specify hot and cold for three takeaway drinks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: サイズはどうされますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 全部小さいサイズで。熱い物と冷たい物は別の袋にしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: サイズと温冷の袋分けを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: All small, please. Could you put the hot and cold drinks in separate bags?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the size and separate bags for hot and cold drinks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、分けてご用意します。歩いてお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, we will prepare them separately. Will you carry them on foot?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自転車ですが、押して帰ります。ホットティーは揺れてもこぼれにくい容器ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自転車を押すと話し熱い容器の漏れを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a bicycle, but I will walk it home. Is the hot tea container unlikely to spill even if it shakes?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will push your bicycle and ask about leakage from the hot drink container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ふたは付きますが、飲み口がありますので傾けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: It has a lid, but there is a drinking opening, so please do not tilt it.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み口があるのですね。熱い方は手で持つので、袋を付けなくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲み口を理解しホットの袋を断る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: So there is a drinking opening. I will carry the hot drink in my hand, so it does not need a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the drinking opening and decline a bag for the hot drink. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、冷たい二つを袋に、熱い一つはそのままお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will put the two cold drinks in a bag and hand you the hot one as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それでお願いします。冷たい方のストローも二本入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最終の分け方とストロー数を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do that. Please also put in two straws for the cold drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the final arrangement and number of straws. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は入口で搬入車を案内してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today you will assist delivery vehicles at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口ですね。車を止める合図は、私が運転手に出すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 搬入時の誘導担当を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: At the entrance, right. Am I the one who signals the drivers to stop?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask who is responsible for vehicle guidance during deliveries. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 誘導は資格と配置を確認した担当が行います。あなたは受付で車名を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Vehicle guidance is done by the person whose qualifications and assignment have been checked. You will match the vehicle names at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は照合だけですね。予定にない車が来たら、入口を開けずに連絡しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付照合担当を理解し予定外車両の対応を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only check them, right. If an unscheduled vehicle arrives, should I contact you without opening the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand your reception checking role and ask what to do about an unscheduled vehicle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです。無線で私に連絡してください。車の前へ出て止めようとしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Contact me by radio. Do not step in front of a vehicle to try to stop it.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 了解です。予定表では九時に二台あります。同じ会社ですが、何で区別しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同時刻の同社車両を区別する項目を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. There are two vehicles scheduled at nine. They are from the same company; what do we use to distinguish them?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check which details distinguish same-company vehicles arriving at the same time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷台の材料名と伝票番号を照合します。まだ届いていない伝票は受付にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Match the material name in the cargo bed and the delivery-slip number. The slips not yet delivered to you are at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付で伝票を受け取ります。雨で無線が聞き取りにくい時はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 伝票を取得し無線不明瞭時の手段を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will collect the slips at reception. What should I do if rain makes the radio hard to hear?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Collect the slips and ask what to use if the radio is unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 無理に通さず、受付内の電話で私を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not try to let them through regardless; call me using the phone inside reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 照合は車名、材料名、伝票番号で行います。判断できなければ電話で連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照合項目と判断不能時の連絡を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will match the vehicle name, material name and slip number. If I cannot judge, I will contact you by phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the matching details and contact method if you cannot judge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、受付へ向かってください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to reception. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布をなくしました。この銀行のキャッシュカードと、別の会社のクレジットカードが入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布に当行と別会社のカードがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost my wallet. It contains this bank's cash card and a credit card from another company.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your wallet contains this bank's card and another company's card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行のカードの利用停止を受け付けます。別会社のカードは、その会社へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can accept a request to stop use of our card. Please contact the other company about its card.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つ別に連絡するのですね。こちらの口座番号はスマートフォンに控えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡先の分離を理解し口座番号控えを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to contact them separately. I have this account number saved on my smartphone.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the separate contacts and show your account-number record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その控えと本人確認書類を拝見します。カードを最後に使ったのはいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will look at that record and your identification. When did you last use the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方です。財布には通帳は入っていません。口座全体も止まるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最終使用日と通帳の所在を述べ停止範囲を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday evening. The bankbook is not in the wallet. Will the entire account be stopped too?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say when you last used the card and where the bankbook is, then ask about the scope of the stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードの停止と口座の取引全体の扱いは分けて確認します。まず紛失カードの停止を進めてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check stopping the card separately from the handling of all account transactions. May we first proceed with stopping the lost card?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、カードを止めてください。再発行の送付先は、新しい住所を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード停止を依頼し新住所への再発行を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please stop the card. I would like the reissued card sent to my new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a card stop and reissue to your new address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所変更が必要か、登録も確認します。再発行はその確認後にご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also check the registration to see whether an address change is needed. You can discuss reissue after that check.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停止をお願いします。住所の確認もしてから再発行を相談し、別会社のカードは自分で連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止と住所確認と別会社への連絡を分けて依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please stop it. I will check the address before discussing reissue, and contact the other card company myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the requests for a stop, address check and contacting the other company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。手続きを進めます。お帰りの際はお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will proceed. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お出口をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for an exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。スーツケースが重いので、階段を使わずに地上へ出たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 階段を避けたい理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My suitcase is heavy, so I want to get to ground level without using stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to avoid stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、この通路の突き当たりのエレベーターで改札階へ上がれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, the lift at the end of this passage can take you up to the ticket-gate floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 改札を出た後も、エレベーターはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 改札後の昇降設備を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is there a lift after going through the ticket gates too?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about lifts after the ticket gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: あります。改札を出て左に進むと、地上行きの乗り場です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. After leaving the gates, go left to the lift that goes to ground level.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奈良公園へ向かうなら、どの出口が近いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 公園に近い出口を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Which exit is closest if I am going to Nara Park?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which exit is close to the park. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 東側の出口です。地上で公園方面の案内板が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The east-side exit. At ground level, you will see a sign towards the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に改札階へ上がって、左のエレベーターで東側へ出るんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二段階の経路を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I go up to the ticket-gate floor first, then use the lift on the left to go out on the east side.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Restate the two-stage route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。改札の手前には広い通路があるので、そこをお通りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. There is a wide passage before the ticket gates, so use that.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 助かりました。荷物を引いて、そちらから出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 教わった経路で出ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: That helps. I will pull my luggage and go out that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave by the route you were shown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お気をつけて。奈良を楽しんでください。

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですか。今日はどうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit? What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。昨日の夕方からのどが痛くて、今朝は熱もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 症状と始まった時期を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my first visit. My throat has hurt since yesterday evening, and I have a fever this morning too.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe your symptoms and when they began. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の体温と、飲んだお薬を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me your temperature now and any medicine you have taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝は三十八度でした。薬はまだ飲んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 体温と服薬の有無を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was thirty-eight degrees this morning. I have not taken any medicine yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer about your temperature and whether you have taken medicine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。お薬のアレルギーはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Do you have any medicine allergies?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前、薬で発疹が出ましたが、名前を覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬で発疹が出た経験を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I had a rash from a medicine before, but I do not remember its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you previously had a rash from medicine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのことも医師に伝えますね。保険の資格を確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will tell the doctor that too. Do you have something confirming your insurance eligibility?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。問診票の「既往歴」は何を書く欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資格確認書類を示して欄の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, here it is. What should I write in the 'past medical history' field on the questionnaire?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show proof of eligibility and ask what the field means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これまでにかかった病気を書く欄です。思い出せないところは、診察で相談できますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write the illnesses you have had before. If you cannot remember something, you can discuss it during the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 喘息があるので書きます。発疹のことも、先生に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持病と診察で伝える事項を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have asthma, so I will write that. I will also tell the doctor about the rash.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mention your ongoing condition and what you will tell the doctor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、問診票を受け取ったらお席へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once we receive your questionnaire, we will show you to a seat. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この千二百円の札は、二キロの袋の値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値札と容量の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Is this twelve-hundred-yen label the price of a two-kilogram bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how the price label relates to the bag size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そうです。隣の五キロは二千七百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. The five-kilogram bag beside it is twenty-seven hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人暮らしなので二キロで十分ですが、こちらの割引は使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要量を伝えて割引を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I live alone, so two kilograms is enough, but can I use this discount?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the amount you need and ask about the discount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その百円引きは、会員アプリのクーポンです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: That hundred-yen discount is a coupon in the members' app.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: アプリは持っていません。会員でなくても安くなる商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一般客が買える特価品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not have the app. Are there any discounted products for nonmembers?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about special offers available to ordinary nonmember customers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの二キロ袋は、今日は千百円です。クーポンは要りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: This two-kilogram bag is eleven hundred yen today. No coupon is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その二つは、同じ種類のお米ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 品種の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Are those two the same variety of rice?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference in rice varieties. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 品種は違います。袋の表に品種名が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: They are different varieties. The variety name is written on the front of each bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、千百円のほうを一袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入する容量と数量を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will take one bag of the eleven-hundred-yen rice.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide the bag size and quantity to buy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計は正面のレジへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please pay at the register straight ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお弁当は温めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like this boxed meal heated?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。お茶は冷たいままで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 弁当だけの加熱を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. The tea is fine cold.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request heating for the boxed meal only. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 温めたお弁当とお茶は、袋を分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like separate bags for the heated meal and tea?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋は一枚でいいです。お茶は自分のバッグに入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の枚数と飲料の扱いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: One bag is enough. I will put the tea in my own bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the number of bags and what to do with the drink. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。お箸は何膳お付けしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. How many pairs of chopsticks would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一膳ください。この交通系カードで払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箸を頼んで支払い方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: One pair, please. Can I pay with this transit card?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request chopsticks and ask about the payment method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、使えます。袋代を含めて七百二十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you can. It is seven hundred twenty yen, including the bag charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残高が足りないときは、現金で払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残高不足時の支払いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the balance is insufficient, can I pay in cash?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to pay if the card balance is insufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その場合は現金でのお支払いに切り替えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, in that case you can switch to cash payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、カードを使います。レシートもください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カード払いとレシートを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will use the card. Please give me a receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to pay by card and receive a receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、レシートです。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your receipt. Thank you.
